title: JHealthBench-L: Clinician-Reviewed Localization of HealthBench for Rubric-Based Medical LLM Evaluation in Japan
abstract: arXiv:2611.34024v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Rubric-based benchmarks such as HealthBench evaluate large language models (LLMs) on open-ended health consultations using case-specific physician criteria, many of which presuppose the healthcare institutions, medications, and care pathways of their source region. Under machine translation alone, these regional assumptions remain in the rubric, leaving responses appropriate in Japan uncredited or falsely penalized under foreign clinical rules. To adapt established clinical evaluation perspectives to Japan without authoring rubrics from scratch, we construct JHealthBench-L (79 patient-facing consultations, 1,022 criteria) through source-cited LLM drafting, single-specialist selection and revision, independent dual-physician review, and meta-review. Specialists rewrote only 4.4% of criteria from scratch, and independent reviewers approved 93.6% of Stage-2 criteria without issue. Comparing JHealthBench-L with a machine-translated baseline

translated_title: JHealthBench-L：面向日本基于评分准则的医学大语言模型评估的临床医生审校版HealthBench本地化
translated_abstract: 诸如HealthBench等基于评分准则的基准测试，使用针对具体病例的医生准则来评估大语言模型（LLM）在开放式健康咨询中的表现，而其中许多准则都预设了其来源地区的医疗机构、药物和诊疗路径。仅靠机器翻译，这些区域性假设仍会残留在评分准则中，导致在日本情境下恰当的回复得不到认可，或被外国的临床规则错误地扣分。为了在不从零编写评分准则的情况下，将已有的临床评估视角适配到日本，我们构建了JHealthBench-L（79个面向患者的咨询，1,022条准则），其构建流程包括：基于引用原文的LLM起草、单一专科医生的筛选与修订、独立的双医生审阅以及元审阅。专科医生仅从零重写了4.4%的准则，独立审阅者对93.6%的第二阶段准则无异议地予以通过。通过将JHealthBench-L与机器翻译基线进行比较……
tldr: 该论文提出了JHealthBench-L，一个通过LLM起草加多阶段临床医生审校流程、将HealthBench的评分准则本地化到日本医疗情境的基准，解决了机器翻译无法消除准则中区域性医疗假设从而导致评估不公的问题。
en_tdlr: JHealthBench-L is a clinician-reviewed localization of HealthBench for Japan, built via a multi-stage expert review pipeline that removes region-specific clinical assumptions from rubrics to enable fair rubric-based evaluation of medical LLMs in the Japanese healthcare context.
